slides.headline: 6 PROMPTS THAT REPLACE A REMOTE MANAGER
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up, triumphant grin, wireless headset, hands on keyboard, bright orange Claude neon sign dominant, four glowing chat-screens behind. Bright 35mm news photo, high-key face lighting, natural skin. Zero readable text. Orange and blue.

slides.headline: 1) SCREEN 200 APPLICANTS DOWN TO 8 IN AN HOUR
slides.body:
A startup saved 3 days of recruiter time. Yours can too.

"Here are 5 resumes: [paste]. Rank them for this remote role: [description]. Flag the top 3 with one reason each"

slides.headline: 2) WRITE PERFORMANCE REVIEWS IN 20 MINUTES
slides.body:
One manager reviewed 8 direct reports in 20 minutes.

"Here are [name]'s last 30 days of updates: [paste]. Write a specific, fair performance review in 3 paragraphs"
slides.image_prompt: Close-up of two faceless hands mid-writing on a blank cream document, the pen catching a motion blur suggesting speed, a finished stack of six identical cream sheets beside them on a warm walnut desk, amber side light raking hard across the surface. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, film grain. Zero readable text. Accent: warm amber against honey walnut brown.

slides.headline: 3) RUN DAILY STANDUPS WITHOUT ATTENDING THEM
slides.body:
A founder saved 6 hours a week. Your team, same deal.

"You are my team lead. Here is our task list: [paste]. Write today's standup in 5 bullet points"

slides.headline: 4) REPLACE STATUS MEETINGS WITH A SINGLE PROMPT
slides.body:
He stopped running weekly status calls. Claude reads the updates and files the report.

"Here are this week's team updates: [paste]. Write a one-page status report with risks and blockers"
slides.image_prompt: Top-down view of a weekly grid planner on a glass desk: eight calendar blocks each crossed with a bold red X symbol, a single small glowing orange card centered on top of the crossed-out grid, vivid teal-green side light flooding the frame bright and saturated, no hands, no faces. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash. Zero readable text. Accent: signal orange against vivid teal green.

slides.headline: 5) ONBOARD NEW HIRES IN 8 DAYS, NOT 3 WEEKS
slides.body:
Your new hire can be fully productive in 8 days instead of 3 weeks.

"Create a 5-day remote onboarding plan for [role]. Include daily goals and one welcome message per day"

slides.headline: 6) RESOLVE A TEAM CONFLICT IN 10 MINUTES FLAT
slides.body:
One founder fixed a 2-week standoff in 10 minutes.

"Here are two teammates' views on a disagreement: [paste both]. Write a fair resolution both sides can accept"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 6 REMOTE TEAM PROMPTS
slides.body:
Screen 200 applicants to 8
20-min performance reviews
No-meeting daily standup
No-call status report
Onboard in 8 days
Conflict fixed in minutes

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe for 6 Claude prompts that handle hiring, reviews, standups, and conflict for your remote team. FORTUNE just confirmed remote workers quit less 📋

These six prompts each replace a task a manager normally handles:
1) screening 200 applicants down to 8 in an hour,
2) performance reviews finished in 20 minutes per person,
3) daily standup written by Claude with no meeting needed,
4) status report generated from one prompt with no calls,
5) new hire onboarding cut from 3 weeks to 8 days,
6) team conflict resolved with one copy-paste prompt.

FORTUNE confirmed this week that fully remote workers report the highest well-being and quit less than anyone. The friction is management overhead. These prompts cut that overhead without cutting the people.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: FORTUNE (Aug 2026 remote worker well-being report), Anthropic
